tasks.analysis: Archaeologists typically study human history and prehistory through the excavation of artifacts buried underground. Sometimes, however, they discover artifacts submerged underwater. A stone wall was found beneath the Baltic Sea in 2012 that dates to over 10,000 years ago. Researchers believe it was used by hunter-gatherer societies to guide and trap reindeer. The wall consists of approximately 1,670 stones and is considered one of the oldest documented hunting structures made by humans. 考古学家通常通过发掘埋在地下的文物来研究人类历史与史前史。然而，他们有时也会发现淹没在水下的文物。2012 年，人们在波罗的海海底发现了一堵石墙，其历史可追溯至一万多年前。研究人员认为，狩猎采集社会曾用它来引导和围捕驯鹿。这堵石墙由约 1670 块石头构成，被认为是有记录以来最古老的人类狩猎建筑之一。
